title: Battle of Turnhout (1597)
text: The Battle of Turnhout, also known as the Battle of Tielenheide, was fought on 24 January 1597 by allied forces of the Dutch Republic and the Kingdom of England against those of the Spanish Empire. The battle took place near Turnhout in the Southern Netherlands, and was part of the Eighty Years' War and the concurrent Anglo-Spanish War (1585–1604).
